messages:
Jess: Heads-up — early flight of retargeting carousel is underperforming. CTR 0.18%, CPA $210. Recommend pausing Creative B and reallocating $3k/day to search top keywords for the next 48h. thoughts?
AdBot: [spend-alert] campaign/retarget-ww crossing pacing threshold (75% of daily cap) — auto-pause set to false.
Maria: Seeing same — Creative B clickthrough is down across FB/IG. Impression share is high but engagement is low. Top performer remains Creative A (CTR 1.1%). If we pause B can we shift budget to Dynamic Product Ads?
Sam: Quick numbers from GA/Ads: last 24h: impressions 420k, clicks 1,230, convs 14. Uplift on search for branded terms predicted to lower CPA to ~$95 if we move $3k. Model: shift -> search bid +15%, add sitelink with promo. I can post the dashboard link in 10m.
Kevin: Agree with reallocating to search for 48h. Also let's not nuke retargeting — refresh instead. Propose we run 2 new variants w/ shorter copy + CTA 'See demo' and 50/50 test against Creative A. Can ops route leads from search to SDR queue with tag 'paid-search'?
Jess: @Kevin yes please route -> Sales via HubSpot mapping. New leads should get `source=paid-search` and `utm_campaign=retarget-reshuffle`. UTM template: 
```
?utm_source=google&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=retarget-reshuffle&utm_term={keyword}
```
Maria: I'll write the creative brief for motion/design, keep B paused for 6h while new variants are built. Also suggest cap bid on dynamic ads to control CPM — set bid cap = $12.
Sam: I'll enable a pacing rule: if CPA > $180 for 2 consecutive checks (30m) then cut spend by 40%. Enabling now.
AdBot: [action] pacing rule enabled by Sam — rule id 7842.
Jess: Action items: Maria — brief + 2 creatives; Sam — enable pacing rule & monitor; Kevin — confirm lead routing + set search sitelinks; I'll reassign $3k/day from retargeting to search. Check-in EOD. :thumbsup: 
Kevin: Confirmed routing setup — tested webhook and sent a test lead (HS id: 55912). :white_check_mark:
Maria: Brief sent to design, ETA ~6h. I'll drop creative comps in #marketing-assets when ready.
Sam: Dashboard refreshed, link posted in thread. I'll keep alerts on and call out any CPA drift.
Jess: Thanks team — let's reconvene at 5pm PT for results and next steps.
Jess: /end
